story.en: The parade starts at 07:00 on Panganiban Drive and continues through Elias Angeles, Caceres and General Luna to the Plaza Quezon stage. The 72 contingents recall the documented 2023 gathering. Uniform colors, six bands, block sizes and the three-hour replay are illustrative; the latter follows the dated 2023 event window.

sources.title: Naga Tourism: 2026 festival calendar
sources.note: Dated event dates and starts. Annual recurrence and depicted formations are illustrative; future arrangements may vary.

sources.title: Naga Tourism: parade traffic advisory and official map
sources.note: Official 2026 map inspected: Panganiban Drive, south on Elias Angeles, west on Caceres, north on General Luna to the Plaza stage. Blue judging area faces the plaza.

sources.title: Philippine Information Agency: 72 contingents in 2023
sources.note: Reports 72 contingents in the September 15, 2023 competition; this does not assert the same count in every year.

sources.title: City of Naga: 2023 parade event window
sources.note: The September 15, 2023 event lists 07:00–10:00. The 2026 start remains 07:00; the replay length is illustrative.
